description: Two copies of the five step sequencer from the Buchla Easel. Each stage holds one voltage, and each stage can be set to send a pulse when the sequence reaches it

params.text: Returns that sequence to its first stage by hand
Switches the pulse of that stage on and off; with it on, the pulse output fires when the sequence reaches that stage
The voltage that stage sends to the CV output, 0V to 10V
Advances that sequence one stage by hand

inputs.text: A pulse returns that sequence to its first stage
A pulse advances that sequence one stage

outputs.text: Fires when the sequence reaches a stage whose pulse is switched on
Carries the voltage of the stage the sequence is on

notes: the number of stages a section runs through, from 2 to 5, is set by dragging its red display
